# MEMORYBLOX Agent Skills

Use this index to find the skill for a task. Each link points to a skill that
exists in this repository. Read the linked `SKILL.md` before you use a skill.

| Skill | Invocation | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [add-feature](add-feature/SKILL.md) | Model | Define a feature and record durable decisions. |
| [dead-code-audit](dead-code-audit/SKILL.md) | Model | Check reported unused code and remove code only when evidence supports removal. |
| [deslop](deslop/SKILL.md) | Model | Remove unnecessary code from a branch diff. |
| [diagnose](diagnose/SKILL.md) | Model | Reproduce and find the cause of a difficult bug. |
| [refactor](refactor/SKILL.md) | Model | Reduce code complexity without a behavior change. |
| [run-quality-gate](run-quality-gate/SKILL.md) | Model | Run the project quality checks and report each result. |
| [full-code-review](full-code-review/SKILL.md) | User | Review code quality and structural risks. |
| [improve-codebase-architecture](improve-codebase-architecture/SKILL.md) | User | Find architecture problems and present options. |
| [goal](goal/SKILL.md) | User | Work toward an objective with checkable completion criteria. |
| [grill-me](grill-me/SKILL.md) | Model | Ask the user to resolve design decisions one at a time. |
| [handoff](handoff/SKILL.md) | User | Record task state for another agent. |
| [teach](teach/SKILL.md) | User | Teach a topic through lessons over multiple sessions. |
| [writing-great-skills](writing-great-skills/SKILL.md) | User | Check the structure and language of a skill. |

`Model` means an agent can select the skill from its description. `User` means
the user invokes the skill by name.
